text:
samir: FYI — spotted an unexpected elevation in an on‑prem tenant after last night's RBAC refactor for private control plane. Audit spike shows service tokens calling admin endpoints.

samir: audit snippet:
```
2026-03-19T23:11:02Z USER=svc-deploy-abc ACTION=POST /v1/controlplane/admin/put-role RESULT=200 GRANTED_ROLE=onprem-admin policy=rbac-2026-03-19 sha256=abc123def
```

elaine: Oof. Which tenants and bindings? can you dump bindings + policy hash?

samir: tenants t-045 and t-210. policy hash above. Looks like the refactor accidentally added a cluster-scoped selector for the service-proxy role (cluster: '*').

kevin: mitigation plan: revoke those bindings and push an emergency deny policy to stop admin endpoint access. I can run:
```
rbacctl revoke-binding --tenant t-045 --binding-id b-892
rbacctl revoke-binding --tenant t-210 --binding-id b-893
rbacctl push-policy --scope global --policy-file deny-temp.json
```

maya: also seeing KMS encrypt failures for t-210 — our audit sink wasn't encrypting so alerts didn't fire reliably.

maya: error from logs:
```
kms: Encrypt failed key=projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/onprem/cryptoKeys/onprem-audit: PERMISSION_DENIED
```

samir: that explains why we missed it earlier. initial spike at 23:11Z, revoke at ~23:18Z. suspected cause: template merge conflict in PR #4128 where cluster selector collapsed to '*' during a rename.

julian: that's my PR — I introduced the change while cleaning up selectors. rolling back the refactor now and will push a hotfix with explicit per-cluster allowlists.

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0034 and page sent to rotation.

kevin: after revoke, run the smoke suite against control-plane admin endpoints to confirm tokens no longer have access. also capture the exact binding ids for rollback.

maya: KMS fix: we need to grant roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on the onprem-audit key to service-account:audit-writer@redwood-prod. who owns that project?

samir: infra-sre owns it — pinging @alex for IAM approval.

alex: I'll add the KMS encrypter role to audit-writer now and verify the sink.

samir: timeline so far — discovery 2026-03-19T23:11Z, revoke 23:18Z, KMS grant in progress 23:40Z, audit backfill started 00:05Z.

elaine: longer term: we need CI lint to block cluster:'*' for onprem control-plane templates and a test that attempts token escalation. also add a pre-deploy check that audit sinks have valid KMS access.

julian: agreed. I'll add a rbac-ci lint rule and a unit test that simulates service-proxy escalation. opening follow-up PR after hotfix.

samir: capturing actions in INC-2026-0034. I'll draft a postmortem tomorrow with root cause: template merge + missing CI guard + KMS gating gap.

kevin: nice work triaging — once backfill completes let's ensure no silent escalations historically.

samir: noted. will add a query for any past binds where role==onprem-admin and source=rbac-2026-03-19.

elaine: :thumbsup: to the quick revoke and KMS follow-up.

samir: :eyes:
